title: Invoice record
purpose: Review the invoice, check its source and charges, and download its PDF or accounting CSV.
summary: Review invoice charges and billing history. Project managers and administrators can issue the invoice, download its PDF, export charges for accounting or record a void.

tasks.title: Check the prepared charges
steps: Review [[Billing snapshot]] and [[Draft lines]] against the intended work.
Select [[Edit]] to correct billing details, descriptions, quantities or prices with a reason.
Select [[Add fee, discount or tax]] to record another charge or assessment on an active draft.

tasks.title: Issue the invoice
steps: Review the billing details and USD total, then select [[Issue invoice]].
Select [[Download invoice PDF]] to save the issued document for delivery.

tasks.title: Cancel a draft
steps: Record why it is no longer needed and confirm. Its snapshot and history stay available.

tasks.title: Void an issued invoice
steps: Select [[Void invoice]] and enter a reason.
If you need a replacement, open [[Chain of custody]] and select [[New draft invoice]].

tasks.title: Export issued charges for accounting
steps: On an issued invoice, select [[Download accounting CSV]].
Map the columns in your accounting software. Match the invoice number against the ledger before importing the charges.
Sum the signed line amounts and check the result against [[Invoice total (USD)]].

good_to_know: Tax is entered manually. Review the assessment after any charge changes.
Issuance locks the draft and stores the PDF. Download the PDF to deliver it yourself.
A void closes the accounting CSV download and keeps the original PDF. Reconcile any earlier export in your accounting software.
A saved due date copies to the PDF. For a draft with net terms and a blank date, you can choose a proposed date in [[Review and issue]].
The draft, PDF and void history are available to project managers and administrators.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can open or change invoice records. Drafts and issued records stay in the staff workspace. Staff issue an active draft from its detail page and deliver the PDF separately. Staff enter tax amounts. The invoice workflow has no payment or accounting entry.

items.label: Client name / Account code
items.description: The client name is required, up to 160 characters; account code is optional, up to 40. Copied from the client at creation and editable on the draft. Editing these labels does not change the source order or its client relationship.

items.label: Invoice-to contact / Invoice email
items.description: Optional contact name, up to 160 characters, and a valid email address. Initially copied from the invoice contact and email; blank invoice values use the primary contact and email. Nothing is emailed.

items.label: Billing address
items.description: Initially the invoice address, or the client mailing address when blank. Optional text, up to 4000 characters when edited. Line breaks are preserved.

items.label: Payment terms
items.description: Optional choices are Due on receipt, Net 15 days, Net 30 days, Net 45 days, Net 60 days and Prepaid. The initial terms come from the client record. Net terms can supply an optional proposal on the issue preview when the draft has a blank due date.

items.label: Due date
items.description: Optional payment date, shown as YYYY-MM-DD or Not recorded. New drafts start blank. Set, change or clear it in Edit with a reason. Past calendar dates are allowed. Issuance freezes the saved date or an explicitly accepted proposal in the issued record and original PDF. Recorded dates are kept with cancelled and voided records.

items.label: Purchase order
items.description: Optional text up to 60 characters. Initially the order PO, or the project standing PO when the order has none. A missing PO is not a draft-creation gate.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Fixed Test, Fee, Discount or Tax. Fees, discounts and tax have no sample or requested test. Tax is always manually added without a quote source. Quoted lines keep their quote number, version and source line; a line added by staff is marked Manually added and has no quote link. Kind and origin remain fixed through edits and cancellation. Discounts are signed amounts, not percentages.

items.label: Status / Internal only / Draft ID / Total
items.description: The header shows the draft ID or invoice number, status, saved billing client and exact USD total. A record with a PDF shows its source draft ID. Draft and Cancelled records are marked Internal only.

items.label: Chain of custody / Project
items.description: Saved source order reference with a link to the current order, and saved project name.

items.label: Price list / Created
items.description: Saved list name/revision for list-priced drafts, plus creation time and responsible staff member. Quote-priced drafts show their accepted quote instead.

items.label: Accepted quote / Quote accepted
items.description: For quote-priced drafts, the saved quote number and version link to that issued quote; the frozen title, acceptance time and accepting account identify the agreed source. This provenance remains fixed through later invoice edits and cancellation. Billing fields still come from the order/client; the quote is not consumed or modified.

items.label: Source sample / Source requested test
items.description: Saved lab ID, client sample ID and disposition, plus the analyte, method/version, matrix and result unit. These source labels remain fixed when descriptions or billing amounts are edited. Quote-priced lines also identify the original quote number, version and line position. Descriptions and prices initially come from that line; the reference remains after reasoned edits. Fee, discount and tax rows show No sample / No requested test instead of sample or test details.

items.label: Description / Quantity / Unit price (USD)
items.description: The editable charge description, positive integer count and whole-cent USD price. Tests, fees and tax use nonnegative prices; discounts use zero or negative prices. Tax quantity is exactly 1. An explicitly entered zero price is allowed.

items.label: Amount (USD) / Draft total (USD) / Invoice total (USD)
items.description: Each amount is quantity multiplied by signed unit price; total is their exact sum and cannot be negative. Values are bounded to the stored precision and never converted through binary floating point.

items.label: Edit / Cancel draft invoice
items.description: Available only while the draft is active. Editing and cancellation require a reason and recheck its revision.

items.label: Add fee, discount or tax
items.description: Append one fee, discount or tax assessment with a reason. The action is disabled after the draft closes or at the 200-line limit. A missing or stale revision is refused. The total must stay nonnegative. Source references remain fixed.

items.label: Cancelled / Voided / History
items.description: Cancelled and Voided show the staff member, time and reason. History tracks creation, edits, line additions, cancellation, issuance and voiding with attributed before and after values.

items.label: Issued
items.description: The invoice number is a distinct identifier. The billing snapshot shows who issued it and when.

items.label: Review and issue
items.description: Opens read-only confirmation for an active draft. A cancelled chain of custody or missing laboratory profile disables the action and shows the reason. Issuance checks the current revision and totals before locking the draft and storing its PDF.

items.label: Download invoice PDF / Download original PDF
items.description: Downloads the original invoice PDF for manual handling. Both Issued and Voided require the same staff access and are checked against the stored file checksum. After a void, the original is retained for reference.

items.label: Download accounting CSV
items.description: Saves the charges from one currently issued invoice. Repeated downloads contain the same lines. Draft, cancelled and voided records have no accounting CSV.

items.label: Void invoice
items.description: Appears on Issued invoices. Give a reason to mark the invoice Voided and free the chain of custody for a fresh draft. The invoice number, original PDF, billing values and history are retained.

sections.title: Source and history
paragraphs: The draft keeps its source chain of custody, project, sample identities, requested test identities, method/version, matrix, unit, disposition and selected price-list name/revision or accepted quote version, acceptance snapshot and source quote lines. Each current requested test on a received sample creates one line, initially quantity 1. Each fee or discount from an accepted quote creates one additional line with its original quantity and signed price, without a sample or test identity. Held, rejected and qualified samples are included with their disposition; the preparer decides whether work is chargeable. Later source corrections, withdrawn tests and price changes do not update the draft.

Each order can have either one active draft or one issued invoice. A draft can have at most 200 combined test, fee, discount and tax lines. Every line and its kind and origin are retained; lines cannot be removed or reassigned. Use Add fee, discount or tax on the draft record to append a manual line with a reason, within the same bounds. To remove an unwanted amount, edit its price to zero with a reason. Cancel a draft and create a replacement to take a new source snapshot. A cancelled draft and its history remain readable. Invoice billing data never changes custody, results or released reports.

sections.title: Accounting CSV columns
paragraphs: Each row identifies one charge by invoice_number and line_position. The issue_date and optional due_date use YYYY-MM-DD. The client_name, client_account_code, order_reference and purchase_order come from the issue. The client account code identifies the customer in the laboratory directory.

The line_type is Test, Fee, Discount or Tax. The description is the one shown on the issued invoice. Tax lines read Tax and keep the staff assessment note private. Currency is USD. Quantity is a count. Multiply quantity by the signed unit_price to obtain line_amount. Sum line_amount once per row to reconcile the invoice total. The synthetic_data column shows whether the invoice carried the synthetic demonstration notice at issue.

Map the CSV to the ledger’s accounts, items and tax treatment. Keep identifier columns as text when leading zeroes matter. Text that could start a spreadsheet formula carries a leading apostrophe. Check these values against the issued invoice when mapping them.

sections.title: Explicit tax assessments
paragraphs: Tax assessments are entered manually on an active draft through Add fee, discount or tax. Each requires a description identifying its basis or source, quantity exactly 1 and a nonnegative whole-cent USD amount. Multiple assessments may be separate lines. Tax lines have no quote, sample or requested-test source. Creation from a price list or accepted quote never creates a tax line.

There are no tax rates, taxability or exemption decisions, or automatic tax calculations. The exact draft total includes every entered assessment. Changing test, fee or discount charges never recalculates tax: review each tax assessment separately after changing charges. Zero retains an explicit assessment; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Tax lines cannot be deleted or change kind; correct an amount to zero with a reason. Cancellation retains the lines and their history.
